title: Describing People
description: Give a short respectful description of a person's appearance and character.
objectives: Give a short respectful description of a person's appearance and character.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to give a short respectful description of a person's appearance and character. The central language is be and have for descriptions. It belongs to the practical context of family & people. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.english: My cousin is friendly and tall.
blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the describing people exchange.
This describing people model adds a different detail or response.
Use this question or response to keep the describing people exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “My cousin is friendly and tall.” and “He has short black hair.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: be and have for descriptions.
